review_summary: Soft Scrub All Purpose Cleanser has an improved formula now packs even more cleaning punch in a faster and easier to rinse formula! It’s perfect for powerful cleaning on sinks, showers, and toilets and removing tough stains from bathroom and kitchen surfaces. It leaves behind a fresh lemon scent once you’re done cleaning. This product is Orthodox Union certified Kosher. Soft Scrub Total All Purpose Bath & Kitchen Cleanser cleans surfaces in the bathroom, kitchen and throughout the house. It removes soap scum, hard water stains, limescale, grease, grime, and food stains, and is safe to use on stainless steel, chrome, granite, porcelain, ceramic, plastic laminate, and glass-top stoves. Caution: Eye irritant. Do not get in eyes. Contains calcium carbonate and detergent. First Aid: Eyes—Flush with water for 15 minutes. If Swallowed—drink a glassful of water. Call physician. Keep out of reach of children. Disposal: Do not re-use empty container. Offer empty container for recycling. If recycling is not available, discard in trash. This package includes one 36 ounce bottle of Soft Scrub All Purpose Cleanser in lemon scent.
pros: Effortlessly tackles tough limescale, soap scum, and baked-on grease
Safe for delicate surfaces including granite, chrome, and glass-top stoves
Fast-rinsing formula leaves a fresh lemon scent and zero heavy residue
cons: Eye irritant that requires cautious handling and proper storage
Abrasive texture requires light pressure on high-gloss plastic surfaces
